'''ApeX R Gaming''' was a Japanese team.

== History ==
ApeX R Gaming won the [[2015 League of Legends Japan League/Season 2/Survival Match|2015 LJL Season 2 Survival]] and qualified to the [[2015 League of Legends Japan League/Season 2|2015 LJL Season 2]].
